messages:
jules: Tiny debate for folks traveling to the Milan offsite 1f11f1
Carry-on only vs checked bag? Also curious about toiletries: TSA-friendly sizes, solid shampoo bars, or buy at destination?

harry: Carry-on only when possible. Saves time at arrivals and zero lost luggage anxiety. But depends on the number of shoes/dress clothes.

marta: For conferences I do a checked bag if I need dresses for dinners. Otherwise, carry-on + laundry at the hotel.

dev: Solid shampoo + laundry soap sheets = less spills and fewer liquids. Also pack liquids in a clear quart bag for security.

jules: Anyone tried refillable silicone travel bottles that collapse? Looking for leak-proof recs.

harry: Get the ones with the push-top and a locking cap. Tested them for a week trip, zero leaks.

marta: Pro tip: if you must check, put a change of clothes and chargers in your personal item. I once had a 36h delay and that saved my day.

dev: Also take a photo of the inside of your checked bag (contents + how you packed). Makes claims easier if it gets rummaged.

ops-bot: Reminder: For international checked luggage, label with your phone number and an email address. Consider a secondary contact info tag inside the bag.

jules: Duty-free q 6d237a
Is it worth buying cheap cologne or snacks duty-free, or better to pick local shops?

harry: For alcohol, duty-free can be a decent deal but compare prices. Local artisanal food/snack shops are nicer for gifting.

marta: Perfume at duty-free is hit or miss. If it's a brand you love, go for it. Otherwise explore local shops for unique gifts.

dev: Quick shoe call: bring one pair of smart-casual shoes that can do double duty (meetings + dinner). Saves space.

jules: Anyone bring a portable steamer vs wrinkle-release spray? I hate ironing in hotel rooms.

harry: Small handheld steamer is worth the luggage space if you need nicer clothes. Wrinkle spray is okay for light fabrics.

marta: Mini poll 44d44e
Carry-on only for this trip?

jules: +1

harry: +1

dev: -1 (bringing shoes/dress)

ops-bot: Poll created: "Carry-on only for Milan offsite". Results: 2 yes, 1 no.

jules: Cool. Last logistics note: if we want to do a quick city walk at 2pm after sessions end, who's up for it? 30-45 minute loop, coffee stop.

harry: In. Great way to stretch after planes.

marta: In too. I'll bring a small list of bakeries to try.

dev: Might be late but if schedules free I'll join.

jules: Sweet. I'll add a calendar + pin meeting spot in the offsite thread. Thanks all! :coffee: :airplane:
